verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a local LLM inference engine with a CLI, a server and a built-in web UI, so offline document chat is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions document ingestion, embeddings-based retrieval or automatic RAG. Offline local chat and vision input are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
